contract: F5 BIG-IP iControl REST, TMOS 15.x-17.x (shapes verified against 17.1 docs, f5-ansible fixtures and f5-common-python; see tools/f5_bigip/SOURCES.md)

filters.partition: Server-side $filter=partition eq <name> on collection tables; other filters are applied client-side as equality / membership after a complete fetch.

cm_devices.description: Device trust members (HA pair/cluster): hostname, management IP, failoverState, version, platform, selfDevice.

fullPath.description: Partition-qualified path, e.g. /Common/web_pool. Use this as the join key and as the `name` control.

generation.description: Configuration generation counter; increments on change.

selfDevice.description: 'true' for the device answering the API.

cm_failover_status.description: Failover status of the device answering the API (ACTIVE/STANDBY...) with detail lines per traffic group.

cm_sync_status.description: Config-sync status of the device group (In Sync / Changes Pending ...).

status.description: In Sync / Changes Pending / Standalone / Disconnected ...

irules.description: iRules with TCL source (apiAnonymous). Join virtual_servers.rules to find where each is attached.

apiAnonymous.description: The iRule TCL source (definition-checksum/signature lines may be embedded).

fullPath.description: Partition-qualified path, e.g. /Common/web_pool. Use this as the join key and as the `name` control.

generation.description: Configuration generation counter; increments on change.

ltm_monitors_http.description: HTTP health monitors: send/recv strings, interval/timeout, destination alias. Secrets (password) are stripped.

fullPath.description: Partition-qualified path, e.g. /Common/web_pool. Use this as the join key and as the `name` control.

generation.description: Configuration generation counter; increments on change.

username.description: Basic-auth user for the probe (password is never returned by the connector).

net_interfaces.description: Physical interfaces: enabled, negotiated media, MAC, MTU, STP.

fullPath.description: Partition-qualified path, e.g. /Common/web_pool. Use this as the join key and as the `name` control.

generation.description: Configuration generation counter; increments on change.

mediaActive.description: Negotiated media, e.g. 10000SR-FD, or 'none' when down.

net_self.description: Self IPs: address/CIDR, VLAN, floating, traffic group, port lockdown.

fullPath.description: Partition-qualified path, e.g. /Common/web_pool. Use this as the join key and as the `name` control.

generation.description: Configuration generation counter; increments on change.

fullPath.description: Partition-qualified path, e.g. /Common/web_pool. Use this as the join key and as the `name` control.

generation.description: Configuration generation counter; increments on change.

node_stats.description: Live node status: monitorStatus, availability, reason, server-side connections.

_object.description: Node fullPath parsed from the stats entry key.

nodes.description: Nodes (backend addresses) with configured state/session and node monitor.

fqdn.tmName.description: FQDN when address is resolved dynamically.

fullPath.description: Partition-qualified path, e.g. /Common/web_pool. Use this as the join key and as the `name` control.

generation.description: Configuration generation counter; increments on change.

partitions.description: Administrative partitions; use their names in the partition filter.

fullPath.description: Partition-qualified path, e.g. /Common/web_pool. Use this as the join key and as the `name` control.

generation.description: Configuration generation counter; increments on change.

pool_member_stats.description: Live pool-member status: monitorStatus (up/down/forced-down/unchecked), sessionStatus, availability reason, connections. Supply parent {"pool": ...}; without it one request per pool is made.

_object.description: Member fullPath parsed from the stats entry key.

pool.description: Parent pool fullPath (added by the connector).

status.statusReason.description: e.g. 'Pool member has been marked down by a monitor', 'Forced down'.

pool_members.description: Pool members (node:port) with configured state/session and monitor. Supply parent {"pool": "/Partition/name"}; without it the connector crawls every pool with expandSubcollections=true and adds a `pool` column.

fullPath.description: Partition-qualified path, e.g. /Common/web_pool. Use this as the join key and as the `name` control.

generation.description: Configuration generation counter; increments on change.

pool.description: Parent pool fullPath (added by the connector).

pool_stats.description: Live pool status: availability/reason, active vs configured member counts, server-side connections and queueing.

_object.description: Object fullPath parsed from the stats entry key.

status.statusReason.description: e.g. 'The children pool member(s) are down'.

pools.description: Load-balancing pools: LB mode, monitor expression, member thresholds.

fullPath.description: Partition-qualified path, e.g. /Common/web_pool. Use this as the join key and as the `name` control.

generation.description: Configuration generation counter; increments on change.

membersReference.items.description: Inline members (only when the client expands subcollections; see pool_members).

monitor.description: Health monitor expression, e.g. '/Common/http' or 'min 1 of { ... }'; 'none' when unmonitored.

serviceDownAction.description: none/reset/drop/reselect when the selected member goes down.

slowRampTime.description: Seconds of slow ramp for new members.

profiles_client_ssl.description: Client-SSL profiles with cert/key/chain, ciphers, SNI and renegotiation settings. Join `cert` to ssl_certs.fullPath to find listeners using an expiring certificate.

cert.description: Certificate fullPath (sys/file/ssl-cert) — join to ssl_certs.fullPath for expiry.

fullPath.description: Partition-qualified path, e.g. /Common/web_pool. Use this as the join key and as the `name` control.

generation.description: Configuration generation counter; increments on change.

profiles_http.description: HTTP profiles (XFF insertion, proxy type, chunking, enforcement).

fullPath.description: Partition-qualified path, e.g. /Common/web_pool. Use this as the join key and as the `name` control.

generation.description: Configuration generation counter; increments on change.

ssl_certs.description: Installed certificates with subject/issuer, SANs and expiry (expirationDate epoch seconds, expirationString text).

expirationDate.description: Expiry as Unix epoch seconds (UTC). Compare with _bow_retrieved_at for days-to-expiry.

fullPath.description: Partition-qualified path, e.g. /Common/web_pool. Use this as the join key and as the `name` control.

generation.description: Configuration generation counter; increments on change.

isBundle.description: 'true' when the file holds more than one certificate.

fullDate.description: Device UTC time (ISO 8601). Compare with _bow_retrieved_at to detect clock skew.

sys_cpu.description: Per-CPU utilisation (5 s / 1 min / 5 min idle, user, system, busy ratio). One row per CPU per host. Undocumented endpoint: key names are flattened from the device response as-is.
sys_cpu.notes: Endpoint existence verified (DevCentral); exact key names inferred from tmsh 'show sys cpu'. Extra keys returned by the device are kept as columns.

sys_hardware.description: Platform, chassis serial and CPU hardware info (single row with dotted group.field columns).

hardware-version.cpus.versions.description: [{tmName, version}] e.g. cores, cache size, cpu MHz.

platform.marketingName.description: e.g. BIG-IP Virtual Edition / BIG-IP i5800.

sys_hardware.notes: platform/* and system-info/* keys verified from f5-ansible bigip_device_info; hardware-version/cpus shape inferred.

sys_memory.description: Host memory per host id: total/used, TMM vs other memory, swap. Undocumented endpoint; keys are flattened from the device response as-is.
sys_memory.notes: memory-host/memory-tmm group keys verified (f5-common-python test, DevCentral); leaf key names beyond memoryTotal/memoryUsed inferred from tmsh 'show sys memory'.

sys_version.description: TMOS software version, build, edition and build date (single row).

virtual_server_stats.description: Live status and counters per virtual server (availability, reason, connections, bits, requests). Counters are cumulative since reset, not rates.

_object.description: Object fullPath parsed from the stats entry key (~Partition~name).

status.statusReason.description: Human reason, e.g. 'The children pool member(s) are down'.

virtual_servers.description: Virtual servers (listeners): destination, default pool, enabled state, profiles, iRules.

fullPath.description: Partition-qualified path, e.g. /Common/web_pool. Use this as the join key and as the `name` control.

generation.description: Configuration generation counter; increments on change.

profilesReference.items.description: Attached profiles when expanded (name, fullPath, context).

rules.description: Ordered iRule fullPaths attached to the listener.

serviceDownImmediateAction.description: none/drop/reset on first SYN when service is down.

sourceAddressTranslation.pool.description: SNAT pool fullPath when type is snat.

synCookieStatus.description: not-activated or activated (SYN flood defence engaged).

vlans.description: VLAN fullPaths the listener is scoped to.

vlansDisabled.description: True when the VLAN list is a deny list.

vlansEnabled.description: True when the VLAN list is an allow list.
